about.title: About
about.abuAlt: Abu, the dog who inspired Diário de Patas, holding the book
about.heading: About the Diary
about.sub: Who we are, how we take care of your data, and how the app works.

story.p1: Diário de Patas was born from our love for Abu.
story.p2: We love his company, his little quirks, and the way he turns an ordinary day into a happier one. He's part of our family — and of so many memories we want to hold on to.
story.p3: We made this space to gather the walks, the naps, the funny faces, and those moments that maybe only make sense to someone who loves a dog the way we love Abu.
story.p4: He's the one in our logo, welcoming you here. A tribute to our companion and an invitation for you to tell your own dog's story.
story.sign2: And for every dog who's part of the family.

about.levelsTitle: Paws, levels, and art of the month
about.levelsIntro: Paws 🐾 are the points you earn on missions (10 or 20 per saved photo). The app counts them two ways:
about.pawsForever: All-time paws: they add up forever and set your dog's level.
about.pawsMonth: Monthly paws: the count starts over on the 1st, with a new adventure. Collect {goal} paws in a month and you earn 1 credit to create art in the Studio (once a month).

privacy.who: Who sees the diary: you and the people you invite, according to each person's role (can add moments or can follow along). A diary manager can remove someone at any time.
privacy.links: Shared links: anyone with the link sees only the photos you chose — no care records, documents, or email. You can revoke it in Profile › Manage diary; revoking doesn't delete copies someone already downloaded.
privacy.where: Where photos are stored: in private storage tied to your account. When you save a photo, we remove its location and other hidden data.
privacy.studio: Studio: only with your permission (asked before the first upload, and you can withdraw it in My account), the photo you pick is sent to Google’s paid API (Gemini) to check the photo and create the art. Under that API’s terms, content isn’t used to train Google products; a record may be kept for a limited time only to detect abuse. The art carries an invisible Google watermark.
privacy.payments: Payments: on the website, card payments are processed by Stripe and Pix by Mercado Pago; in the iPhone app, purchases go through Apple. The app never sees card or bank details.
privacy.push: Phone notifications: go through your device's notification service (Apple or Google). You can turn them off in My account › Notifications.
privacy.delete: Deleting: in My account › Delete my account, or just one diary in Profile › Manage diary.

about.studioText: Each piece of art shows up in the diary with the “🎨 Studio art” badge and counts toward the memory limit. If the diary is full, the art isn't created and no credit is used.

install.intro: It gets its own icon and opens full screen, just like an app. It's free and doesn't need the App Store.
install.otherBrowser: If you don't see the option, open diario-de-patas.vercel.app in Safari and repeat the steps.
install.step1Safari: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar (at the bottom or top of the screen).
install.step1Browser: Tap Share in the browser toolbar (at the bottom or top of the screen).

s0.title: Hi, I'm Abu!
s0.text:
My life is full of walks, naps, and a little mischief worth remembering.
I bet your dog's life is too.
Want to save those stories together?

s1.title:
To you, it's a photo.
To me, it's a day with you.
s1.text:
The usual walk, a nap on the couch, that pose for a treat… Our album lives in the little things.
Shall we save your favorites?

s2.title:
An album all their own.
Full of you two.
s2.text: The first adventure, the favorite toy, a thousand sleeping positions. Gather the photos and watch your dog's story find a home of its own.

s3.title: So many adventures ahead!
s3.text: A silly nap, a new walk, a pose with the favorite toy. Missions give you ideas for capturing these moments, so the diary looks just like your dog.

s4.title: A family diary.
s4.text: Invite everyone who loves your dog too. Each person joins with their own account to save photos, write letters, and leave bones. Grandparents can just follow along.

s5.title:
Now you know me.
So, who's your best friend?
s5.text: Tell me their name and pick a photo. We have so many adventures ahead!
